title: Vulkan validation errors on startup in vkCmdCopyBufferToImage
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.beta2.mono.official [a013481b0]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta2.mono - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 18 Jan 2025 02:26:57 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (amdgpu) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

A number of Vulkan validation errors are emitted from the validation layer. This doesn't seem to cause any problems, but doesn't seem right anyway. (I'm secretly hoping it's related to #101492 but probably not...) Example:

> ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 233709312
>
> Validation Error: [ VUID-vkCmdCopyBufferToImage-imageOffset-07738 ] Object 0: handle = 0xdee1f00, type = VK_OBJECT_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER; Object 1: handle = 0x8f1c31000000006d, type = VK_OBJECT_TYPE_IMAGE; | MessageID = 0xcae1744e | vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(): pRegions[0].imageExtent (width = 4, height = 4, depth = 1) dimensions must be even integer multiples of this command buffer's queue family image transfer granularity (width = 16, height = 16, depth = 8) or offset (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) + extent (width = 4, height = 4, depth = 1) must match the image subresource extents (width = 4, height = 4, depth = 4).
>
> The Vulkan spec states: The imageOffset and imageExtent members of each element of pRegions must respect the image transfer granularity requirements of commandBuffer's command pool's queue family, as described in VkQueueFamilyProperties (https://www.khronos.org/registry/vulkan/specs/1.3-extensions/html/vkspec.html#VUID-vkCmdCopyBufferToImage-imageOffset-07738)
> 
>    at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665)

<details>
